items.title: [DC] psychefu@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: Issues with the latest announcements:  1)    Having silver in the high score ran
items.summary:
Issues with the latest announcements:

1)    Having silver in the high score range is dumb and very frustrating for a new player. There is no way a new or casual player will ever get those scores in a reasonable amount of time. Especially when upgrading materials are limited as hell and also locked behind difficulty. It's so so so so unfriendly and has way too many barriers.

2) Its true that the silver actually equals very little rolls—but, it’s still a massive fear of missing out aspect that pushing this game into really unfriendly territory. The idea of limiting players by having upgrading materials locked behind extremely difficult content is already dumb and makes it SUPER hard for new players to catch up. Now adding fear of missing out into the mix and at a difficulty less than 10% of the player base is at is just an insult to the majority of the player base.

3) If there are to be rewards in the higher level it should be icons and banners/borders instead. Cosmetic and bragging rights is the way to go.

4) Difficulty should be scaled with the perceptive that Morimens is a game—not for treating Morimens like every player’s job or personal project (i.e., avoid adding tedious stuff within reason. Locking upgrade materials and silver behind millions of HP does not treat Morimens as a game.

5) There was a promise of "you won't need AA for end game content"—where did this perceptive go? Likewise, is Silver not counted as "meaningful rewards"? What the heck does "meaningful rewards" mean then? (see image)
[附件: image.png]
  └ psychefu: Have to send as multiple messages since I don't have discord Nitro... so here is **Part 2**. There will be a **Part 3** later (once the 30 minutes timer has ended and I get back from grocery shopping I guess) as well...

6) Adding Revive does not make increasing HP bloat better. Others have already noted that these DTide changes becomes “more of a chore for casuals when they have to struggle with limited amounts of revives per season with much harder enemies just to get all pulls instead of calling it a day at 325.” I personally agree with this. I wonder how many new players are doing this strategy (I certainly was when I started out about 1 year ago). It’s also worth noting that this style of play pushes the gap between old players and new players wider. Which means BIAV will have even bigger issues going forward as the gap gets bigger and bigger between old and new players. There is a reason other games have a "ceiling" of difficulty. Like Genshin doesn't even have massive power creep and it has been years since its release. Likewise, Arknights is designed at a certain level of difficulty no matter how much power creep is in the new units. That or BIAV really need to add catch up events for new players. Or... have new units be so overpowered that old units become irrelevant (which I don't want to happen and clearly BAIV doesn't too with their character buffs)

P.S., I have a word Doc version too if you want that, just DM me
items.author: psychefu

items.title: [DC] princess.goth@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: Lets begin with the dzone changes, i think changing dtide as a mode is just a re
items.summary:
Lets begin with the dzone changes, i think changing dtide as a mode is just a really weird choice overall since its the only thing that keeps players logging in and actually playing the game. Other modes need way more assistance so i would hope they dont get left for dead (especially pdive).
I think essentially adding 2 difficulty tiers is quite weird? why are we straight up ignoring the challenge even one new difficulty brings and adding another one on top? also the rewards allocation makes no sense why are the silver rewards less attainable now than before. Furthermore i dont understand the gnosis change and think its quite stupid, auto was removed for dtide since its an endgame gamemode to really test your skills and now we are able to use revives in it? what was the point of that is the game mode pro or con casual players?

I would also like a more general overhaul of train, madness is essentially a reset fest, trying to get the right relics/setup/bosses etc and just adding one new endboss feels like essentially 0 improvements to the mode with some random boss to now smash.

When it comes to the affinity system i like the changes in concept, especially being able to ear level up materials is really nice. What i dont think is acceptable is the cost of the items you need to buy. 50.000 currency is an INCREDIBLY out of touch amount to ask for and im wondering how you could possible end up at that number and think its okay. I also like the idea of a cosmetic for a character you love, but it having 0 individuality and essentially costing 250.000 currency is quite disappointing. Please reward your players more for their love of their characters. (i say this as someone whos starving for more corposant)

In addition to that i think the covenant binding system is stupid. The best part about morimens artifact system is how flexible it is and binding takes all of that away. You just overhauled the affinity system and could have easily just made it so covenants gain affinity aswell so after using the covenant a bunch your character now gets more stats. this currently presented system makes me quite angry in having wasted resources on multiple covenants for 1 character like vortice for different situations when it seems like i can only bind one. also we are essentially being taxxed for a quality of life feature, swapping covenants which makes 0 sense to me.
items.author: princess.goth

items.title: [DC] momvolo@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: -> Story mode change is good. However, I believe the hard mode arc 2 story is pr
items.summary:
-> Story mode change is good. However, I believe the hard mode arc 2 story is progressing at a pace that makes it difficult for beloved older units to keep up. The changes in 2.7 may alleviate this. 

-> I do not like Train and cannot weigh in on its changes. So long as the monthly mission is doable on the easiest difficulty, like Traphase, I do not care at all. 

-> DTide changes are fine. The ability to gnosis while taking away its prestige for score is an excellent balance point between tryhards and those just in it for rewards. And to those who think f2p/newbies will be adversely effected by challenges at the top: They don't have the exp farmed up to actually level those units. We all know it. It's just a dead resource for early game accounts. 

-> Bond 16-20 and bond changes are an interesting concept! I like the change to how bond grinding works, now rewarding long gameplay turns with more affection with units such as Tawil or Pontos. However, 50 000 currency is too much for uncap materials. Requiring a grand total of- 

# **250 000 D Jewels**

-Over 5 months is completely and entirely unacceptable. Lightless and badge conversions are even more pricy. You are unlocking the exchange to unlimited in the sediment shop, and are trying to bait whales into buying via sediment. This system is too expensive. Please change the numbers before it goes live. This is terrible and untenable pricing.

-> Covanent changes are in effect useless. If the binding can be undone with 10 pieces, you're only taxing endgame players a little and hurting new to middle tier players a lot. This is bad. Make the buffs permanent or make the tax meaningful, because the system as it is has only grown more annoying and burdensome. 

-> Gnosis should remain in the sediment shop instead of in a pop-up menu. Pop-ups are disliked by almost all players for being intrusive, negatively impacting gameplay experience and being predatory. They are also not lore relevant ay all. There is nothing positive or defensible about this change. 

Thank you for reading this, and I hope some price points and implementations can be reconsidered by the team before these changes go live.
items.author: momvolo

items.title: [DC] sunyandmony@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: I won't be a parrot and repeat everything already said, so I'll do it in my own
items.summary:
I won't be a parrot and repeat everything already said, so I'll do it in my own words + biased opinions

1. The story mode access thing is very nice, but please don't let hp inflation affect the chapters later down the road! Not exactly everyone can predict you'll be greeted with some 20m hp boss at some point while on normal mode at that.. 

2. Rewards being added to make pvp mode/traphase more relevant is a good thing, but it feels a little weird to add them there for some reason.. It would've been better to try and make that mode relevant through other means, like an increase in pulls or silver gains 

3. The Awakener customization frame thingy... I have a very strong opinion on this. I feel like it shouldn't be locked over +15 affinity, nor does it deserve the price it is tagged with. I understand the issues and whatnot with this, but making them different for each Awakener would at least somewhat explain the cost and means, rather than them being similar (example: for Castor and Pollux, they could have matching effects, Arachne could have spider webs, Jenkins little rats, etc etc) and super expensive all at the same time. 

4. As for covenants, I think it's fairly obvious every player here feels at least relatively the same way. So I won't go into it.

5. D-tide, oh man here we go.. While I like a good challenge, I feel like adding so many new things, like a nightmare mode and A6 and A7 will make it a little hard to play, even for people with already invested-in accounts. I do not wish for this game mode to be centered on how much we can spend until the unit is passable enough to clear the content. Additionally, I pray with my heart and soul and everything that I am, to not do hp inflation so early on. Not everyone has cleared the game mode with a full score. If veterans want a challenge, then let them have one. But casual players will definitely feel a lot more pressure on their shoulders as time goes on.
items.author: sunyandmony

items.title: [DC] caelumace@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: I forgot to include this in my main thing (that I'm replying to to continue off
items.summary:
I forgot to include this in my main thing (that I'm replying to to continue off of) but removing soulforges is a foolish endeavor. Most characters released in arc 2 were designed around or with their soulforge passive in mind (most notably Murphy: Fauxborn who relies on her faction passive specifying "other lemurians", and Arachne who gets her Final Verdict *doubled* while it's not able to recieve most other buffs due to being a singular insulated mechanic). These characters would be completely crippled and useless without these passives intact, especially compared with other future units who will have an arc 3 passive baked into their kits the same way. This also affects arc 1 units who had complete, if outdated, kits who got new life and new use through their soulforge mechanics and became archetype-defining. To scrap Casiah's passive, one of the biggest enablers of Discard teams, would be to hinder the entire team building around them especially when such strong characters like Pontos rely almost entirely on that passive. Other characters received unique synergies like Goliath who despite having no interaction with tentacle damage received a buff that made him work well with the aforementioned iteration of Murphy. Without these passives these fan favorites will fade into obscurity and have no reason to use them going into arc 3. There is the argument that these passives will be part of the new ones to avoid nerfing them post purchase, but that would be lazy design. I have an alternative. 

Instead of replacing passives, make them additive. This keeps characters not only where they are and as strong as they are, but also allows them to become even stronger with new mechanics and new characters. Expand upon Lemurian team building, or develop the poison/counter/bleed/discard archetypes without trying to bulldoze over what was already made. Players shouldn't have to memorize multiple distinct kits for the same character.
items.author: caelumace

items.summary:
My opinion is:
1. The choice of normal mode vs. hard mode is a great thing - new players I have introduced have complained that ch1-6 is way too easy.
2. I really like the increased difficulty of dtide. As a ~400 5 team player I want the content to be harder to challenge myself. But I think the rewards should be moved around a little since many players who care about silver get 325 in the current dtide. 400 to get all the silver seem like a better choice to me while pyramid acquistion could be rebalanced. 
3. I don't like the covenant change. Nobody liked farming for these. How about allowing covenant sets to be overlapping instead and go with the design philosiphy of sharing covenants? Binding in the non-literal sense makes more sense - aka when you auto equip, you can choose which cov set you want the character to use.

items.title: [DC] orinatic@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: Yeah, I like the covenant bonding, because it makes using a specific covenant fo
items.summary:
Yeah, I like the covenant bonding, because it makes using a specific covenant for a specific character feasible. For example, if I want a TTB with sigil yield for GLotan specifically, right now doing it 'properly'  is a  *huge* investment for a somewhat niche application.

Covenant bonding makes that kind of specific-awakener-covenant feasible.

Only caveat is that yeah, new content definitely shouldn't be ballanced around having it. Or at least dtide/you-want-multiple-teams-for-this really really shouldn't. But barring that, I think it's a great idea.

items.title: [DC] bu0465_15110@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: Overall, pretty disappointing. I understand why players want more challenge, but
items.summary:
Overall, pretty disappointing. I understand why players want more challenge, but this just seems like a bad time for most players involved. It will feel unrewarding (since now 400 felt like perfect clear and 425 was that extra cherry on top). Why not actually pour some resources into a new game-mod that will have different difficulty baked in or will be more challenging? Or why not just A6? 

Train is boring and long, adding extra boss does nothing to remedy that.

Binding goes against recently added covenants that were perfect for mixing up realms. Now if I give Clem her conventant for caro team and I decide to bind it, I can say goodbye to playing her anywhere else. Not too mention that some conventants cannot double in the team. So my Corpo from Pontos team (Dream Medicine) can never be slotted with my GMurphy (Dream Medicine). If unbiding is easy and cheap, then what's the point in this mechanic at all.

Overall this feels like: greed, desperation and disappointement all over again.

The "same" card effect for absurd amount of in-game currency feels like a joke. Minimum effort from the devs, maximum cost for the players. You can't even make unique effects for the cards after demanding so much time and resources from the players?
items.author: bu0465_15110

items.summary:
